overview_description.description:
Lendo is an alternative lending marketplace that helps digitally finance small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in Saudi Arabia.
Lendo was granted the first Crowdlending (debt financing) licensed in Saudi Arabia, and received the Excellence in Finance Leaders Award from FiNext Awards.
Lendo’s products and solutions make everyday business activities easier, more secure, and more efficient for both investors and borrowers alike.

about_short_description.short_description: Lendo is an alternative lending marketplace that helps digitally finance small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in Saudi Arabia.

product.name: Invoice Financing
product.description: A service that provides immediate cash liquidity to SMEs by financing their accounts receivable invoices.

product.name: Purchase Order Financing
product.description: A financing product that supports SMEs by providing funds against purchase orders to help grow their business operations.

product.name: Short-term Investment Opportunities
product.description: Investment options for individuals to invest in short-term financing opportunities for SMEs, with returns based on credit risk assessments.

product.name: Auto-Invest Feature
product.description: An automated investment tool that manages and diversifies investor portfolios across available financing opportunities.

product.name: Credit Risk Assessment and Scoring
product.description: A credit evaluation system that uses multiple data points and integrations with Saudi credit bureaus to assess the risk of financing opportunities.
